svg.title: HAU-Sync Level 1 data flow diagram
svg.desc: The seven processes of HAU-Sync, their seven data stores and the data flows between them and the Clinic Staff, Doctor and Clinic Coordinator.

text.tspan: HAU-Sync: Patient Record Management and Appointment System
Archive or restore a patient record
Every process that changes a record also writes an audit entry to D7; only the flow from 7.0 is drawn. The Clinic Coordinator can also do everything Clinic Staff and the Doctor can.
Patients do not use the system: clinic staff enter their details. Each flow to or from an external entity appears with the same wording in the Level 0 diagram.
